With the Tenable Web App Scanning API, you can get a filtered list of detected vulnerabilities.
For background information, see the Tenable Web App Scanning User Guide.
— 202
Returned if Tenable Web App Scanning successfully created the deletion job for the user-defined
template.
400 Returned if your request specifies an invalid UUID for a user-defined template.
404 Returned if Tenable Web App Scanning cannot find the specified user-defined template.
409 Returned if you attempt to delete a user-defined template still in use by a scan configuration.
— 429
Returned if you attempt to send too many requests in a specific period of time. For more information,
see Rate Limiting.
